question: Under the Ayushman Vaya Vandana Yojana launched in October 2024, every Indian citizen aged 70 years and above will get free health insurance up to what amount every year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹5 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ayushman Vaya Vandana Yojana** is a government-backed pension scheme designed to ensure financial security for senior citizens aged **70 years and above**.
 
• Under this scheme, beneficiaries receive free health insurance coverage of up to **₹5 lakh** annually.
 
• It aims to provide a safety net for senior citizens, covering hospitalization expenses for both **secondary and tertiary healthcare services**.
 
• The scheme was introduced to address the financial burden of healthcare costs for elderly citizens in India, ensuring their access to quality medical services.
 
• It is fully funded by the Government of India and implemented through designated channels such as **insurance providers** and healthcare institutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY):**

 
 
• **Ayushman Bharat** is a flagship health insurance scheme launched by the Government of India to provide free healthcare access to economically vulnerable families.
 
• This scheme offers health insurance coverage of up to **₹5 lakh per family per year**, catering to low-income groups.
 
• It covers both **secondary and tertiary care hospitalization** across empanelled public and private hospitals.
 
• The scheme is fully financed by the Indian government and serves as an essential step toward achieving universal healthcare.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility Criteria for Ayushman Vaya Vandana Yojana:**
 
 
• This scheme is specifically designed for **Indian citizens aged 70 years and above**.
 
• The beneficiaries must not be covered under other government-backed insurance schemes like **ESIC** or **EPFO**.
 
• It requires proper verification documents such as Aadhaar cards and financial statements to ensure transparency and eligibility.
 
 
 
• **Implementation and Management:**
 
 
• The scheme is implemented through agencies such as the **Life Insurance Corporation (LIC)** and other government-approved organizations.
 
• Hospitals empanelled under the scheme are required to provide cashless treatment to beneficiaries.
 
• The government closely monitors the scheme's implementation to ensure its effective reach among eligible citizens.
 
 
 
• **Significance of ₹5 lakh Coverage:**
 
 
• The coverage of **₹5 lakh annually** addresses the financial challenges faced by senior citizens due to expensive healthcare.
 
• This amount is sufficient to cover most hospitalization expenses, including surgeries and critical care treatments.
 
• It significantly reduces out-of-pocket expenses for elderly citizens, enabling them to access quality healthcare without financial stress.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Government Initiative:**

 
 
• The scheme aligns with India's commitment to improving healthcare access for vulnerable sections of society.
 
• It complements other government initiatives like **AB-PMJAY** and **National Health Mission** aimed at achieving universal health coverage.
 
 
 
• **Healthcare Financing:**
 
 
• The scheme is fully financed by the government, ensuring its sustainability and widespread impact.
 
• It reduces dependency on private insurance providers, making healthcare more accessible to economically weaker sections.
 
 
 
• **Focus on Senior Citizens:**
 
 
• By targeting citizens aged 70 years and above, the scheme addresses the specific healthcare needs of elderly individuals.
 
• It ensures that senior citizens can live with dignity and without financial worries related to health emergencies.
